name: Draft and critique professional performance evaluations
description: Users requested assistance in drafting, refining, or critiquing formal performance assessments, self-evaluations, and feedback documents for various professional, academic, and interpersonal contexts. These requests frequently involved applying specific rubrics, addressing particular criteria such as leadership or technical skills, and formatting responses for official reviews, internships, or educational programs.
